records.claim: Before the frozen stop, all four executed pairs used exact shared terminal ancestry, one review call per arm, sole slate exposure, and bounded paired cost. Their fixed-denominator descriptive contribution was +0.0378684 macro Span-F1 with positive span and file coverage and precision differences.
limitations: The pressure fallback was not exercised before the stop.
The run stopped after four complete pairs, so the descriptive quality difference is not a completed canary estimate.

records.claim: The fifth prefix reached the fixed 2,048-token output cap on its third model call. With zero correction attempts frozen, the runtime retained the failed receipt but returned run_error instead of creating a review boundary, and the global stop left four pairs unstarted.
limitations: No retry or task replacement occurred.
The output-pressure boundary is not yet implemented or tested.
